export default "# orchestra-checkbox\n\n## Accessibility and Usability Notes\n\n- Always provide an accessible name using one of these patterns:\n  - linked external label via `html-id` and `<label for=\"...\">`\n  - `aria-label`\n  - `aria-labelledby`\n- Add contextual guidance or error references with `aria-describedby`.\n- Effective hit target is intentionally larger than the visual 16x16 control for better pointer and touch usability.\n\n## Interaction Model\n\n- Deterministic state cycle on user interaction:\n  - `indeterminate` -> `checked`\n  - `checked` -> `unchecked`\n  - `unchecked` -> `checked`\n\n## Form and Validation APIs\n\n- `checkValidity()` returns current validity state.\n- `reportValidity()` triggers browser validation UI.\n- `setCustomValidity(message)` sets or clears custom validation text.\n- Required unchecked fields expose `aria-invalid=\"true\"` and report validity errors.\n\n\n\n<!-- Auto Generated Below -->\n\n\n## Properties\n\n| Property
